data.name: Hint_Body
data.value: On your iPhone or iPad, open Control Centre, tap Screen Mirroring and choose:

data.name: Hint_StoppedBody
data.value: Press Start receiving (or Ctrl+R) to let your iPhone find this PC.

data.name: Pin_Title
data.value: Enter this code on your iPhone

data.name: Ask_Body
data.value: {0} wants to mirror to this PC. Replace {1}, or keep {1} and refuse?

data.name: R_Rotate
data.value: Turn the window when the phone rotates

data.name: R_Info
data.value: Show picture info over the picture

data.name: Monitor_Same
data.value: The one the window is on

data.name: R_Reset
data.value: Back to the picture as the phone sends it

data.name: R_Audio
data.value: Play the sound on this PC

data.name: R_Startup
data.value: Run when I sign in to Windows

data.name: R_UpdateCheck
data.value: Check for updates when LiteMirror opens

data.name: H_Name
data.value: The AirPlay service name announced on the LAN over mDNS. Empty uses the computer name.

data.name: H_AutoStart
data.value: Register the mDNS service and start listening as soon as the app starts. Otherwise press Start receiving or Ctrl+R.

data.name: H_Pin
data.value: Require Digest authentication at RTSP SETUP. "New code" generates a random 4-digit code per connection and shows it here; "Fixed PIN" uses the code below.

data.name: H_PinCode
data.value: The PIN used in fixed mode, 1 to 63 characters.

data.name: H_Second
data.value: What to do with a new connection while a session is active: ask (no answer within 15 s refuses), refuse (reply 453), or drop the current session and accept the new one.

data.name: H_Address
data.value: Listen and announce on one adapter's IPv4 address only. For choosing the interface with several adapters, a VPN or virtual adapters.

data.name: H_Hotspot
data.value: The phone can join a hotspot of this PC, or the PC can join the phone's personal hotspot, over Wi-Fi or over USB with Apple's USB network driver. The mirror then runs over that link with no router in between; nothing to set here. The button opens the Windows hotspot page: Windows needs a Wi-Fi adapter and a connection it can share, and turns the hotspot off after five minutes without a device.

data.name: H_Ports
data.value: Listening ports for RTSP (RAOP) and HTTP (AirPlay), for firewall rules. 0 lets the system assign them.

data.name: H_Quality
data.value: The target resolution advertised to the sender (16:9, by height), which encodes accordingly. Lower means less bitrate and decode load.

data.name: H_Fps
data.value: The maximum frame rate advertised to the sender.

data.name: H_Hw
data.value: Decode H.264 on the GPU through Media Foundation. Off switches to software decoding at a much higher CPU cost; for isolating driver problems.

data.name: H_Low
data.value: Decoder in AVLowLatencyMode, Present with interval 0 and one frame in the DXGI queue instead of three; in full screen the present skips the vertical blank (tearing allowed). Off presents on vsync with the default queue: two to four frames more delay, no tearing.

data.name: H_Scaler
data.value: Interpolation used when the picture is smaller than the window. "Standard" is the D3D11 video processor (driver); "Sharp" is a Catmull-Rom bicubic shader with crisper edges and one extra full-screen pass.

data.name: H_Super
data.value: Only matters while the picture is smaller than the window; takes the place of the enlarging method. AMD FSR 1.0: open spatial upscaler, two shader passes (EASU, RCAS), any feature level 11 GPU, under a millisecond. RTX VSR / Intel VSR: the driver's own model on the video processor, 4 to 8 ms of GPU time per frame; the driver applies it only when GPU, driver version and control panel allow, and says nothing when it does not, so the picture may equal Standard. The picture is processed on the GPU that drives the monitor the window is on when receiving starts.

data.name: H_Rotate
data.value: When the sender switches orientation the window is re-laid out at the new aspect ratio with the same area. Off keeps the window and letterboxes.

data.name: H_Info
data.value: Overlay in the top-left corner with resolution, frame rate, per-frame processing time and decoder. Ctrl+I toggles it.

data.name: H_Monitor
data.value: The monitor used by F11 full screen on a multi-monitor setup.

data.name: H_Matrix
data.value: The YCbCr to RGB conversion matrix. The stream carries no colour description, so "Auto" goes by resolution: BT.709 above 576 lines, BT.601 otherwise.

data.name: H_Range
data.value: The nominal YCbCr range. "Auto" treats it as limited (16–235), matching AirPlay senders; "Full" interprets it as 0–255.

data.name: H_Brightness
data.value: The D3D11 video processor brightness filter; -100 to 100 is mapped onto the driver's range. 0 is off.

data.name: H_Contrast
data.value: Contrast filter, mapped the same way. 0 is off.

data.name: H_Saturation
data.value: Saturation filter; -100 is greyscale. 0 is off.

data.name: H_Hue
data.value: Hue filter, a shift round the colour wheel. 0 is off.

data.name: H_Audio
data.value: Receive and play the AirPlay audio stream. Off leaves the sound on the sender.

data.name: H_AudioDevice
data.value: The WASAPI output device. "Default device" follows the Windows default output.

data.name: H_Volume
data.value: Volume changes from the sender (RTSP SET_PARAMETER volume) set this app's session volume in the Windows mixer.

data.name: H_Theme
data.value: Light or dark. "Same as Windows" reads the Windows app mode setting and follows changes to it.

data.name: H_Startup
data.value: Writes a Run entry under HKCU so the app starts at sign-in, straight into the tray.

data.name: H_UpdateCheck
data.value: One request to api.github.com for the latest release tag at start. A newer version is announced in the corner and on the About page; nothing is downloaded or installed.

data.name: H_Close
data.value: Closing the window quits the process, or only hides the window and keeps receiving with a tray icon.

data.name: H_Log
data.value: Log level, written to %AppData%\LiteMirror\logs. Choose "Everything" when reporting a problem.

data.name: About_Desc
data.value: A small AirPlay receiver for Windows: mirror your iPhone or iPad screen, with sound, to this PC.

data.name: About_Licence
data.value: Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3.

data.name: Msg_AppliesLater
data.value: This change applies after the current phone disconnects.

data.name: Msg_AddressFallback
data.value: The chosen network adapter is not available; receiving on all adapters.

data.name: ErrNoDecoder
data.value:
No H.264 video decoder was found.
On Windows N editions, install the Media Feature Pack (Settings > Apps > Optional features), then start LiteMirror again.

data.name: ErrMdnsUnavailable
data.value: LiteMirror needs Windows 10 version 1809 or later.

data.name: ErrMdnsRegister
data.value: Windows could not announce LiteMirror on the network. Check that the computer is on the same Wi-Fi as your phone and that the network is set to Private.

data.name: ErrPort
data.value: Another program is using a network port LiteMirror needs. Close it, or choose other ports in Settings.

data.name: ErrNoD3D
data.value: Direct3D 11 is not available on this computer, so the picture cannot be shown. Update the graphics driver and try again.

data.name: ErrAddress
data.value: The chosen network adapter has no address right now.
